newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela raises reserve requirement to 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela raises reserve requirement to 15 pct.

text.p: Venezuela's Central Bank said Thursday it had increased commercial banks' reserve requirements to 15 percent from 12 percent.

"Financial institutions are informed that following a decision by the board of directors on July 10, reserve requirements will rise to 15 percent as of Monday," the Bank said in a release on the Reuters screen BCVVO3.
Under Central Bank regulations, commercial banks will now have to place 15 percent of their deposits in non-interest bearing accounts at the Central Bank.
